origin: Previously built and browser-tested standalone editor; this change packages its pinned output. The upstream source is not rebuilt on every Maven invocation.
selection: Webpack-emitted runtime JS/CSS, image/font/WASM assets, third-party licenses and upstream LICENSE. Excludes sourcemaps, generated package metadata, lockfile and public playground media.
rebuild: bash labeling-service/scripts/rebuild-editor-assets.sh; review regenerated bundle, checksums, licenses and browser behavior before accepting an update.
